How to read this dashboard
Opportunity Score blends reward per miner, trend, available price/emission data, and competition.
USD / Miner is estimated 24h USD emission divided by active miners. Higher is usually more interesting.
Growing means miners are moving into the coin; declining means miners are leaving.
Data Quality warns when price, emission, source link, or activity is missing.
